This premium pricing is fundamentally disconnected from the company’s operational performance, as evidenced by a return on assets of 0% compared to a sector benchmark of 3.94% [E8]. The long-term profit trajectory is equally concerning, with compounded profit growth stagnating at 0% over the last decade and declining by 59% over the last three years [E18, E20]. Furthermore, investors receive no compensation for these risks, as the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: the company has shown a recent 14% improvement in profit growth over the trailing twelve months and is currently trading at 70% of its 52-week range [E5, E21]. Despite these minor signs of momentum, the massive disparity between the company's P/E ratio and its sector peers suggests that the current market capitalisation of ₹ 37.2 Cr is not supported by the underlying financial reality [E3, E6].
